name: macropulse
description: MacroPulse AI — macroeconomic intelligence and technical-recession early-warning platform

scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && uv sync --all-packages && pnpm db:upgrade
scripts.gen:types: uv run macropulse openapi --out packages/shared-types/openapi.json && pnpm --filter @macropulse/shared-types gen
scripts.lint:api: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy
